connections_intro: Connections show who your listing has worked with. A connection becomes public only when both listings agree.
connections_no_listing: You need a published listing before you can propose connections.
connections_unclaimed_hint: These listings have no owner yet. Confirm a connection only if you can vouch for it.
connections_unclaimed_note: This listing has no owner yet. The proposal waits until someone claims it.
connections_withdraw_body: It stops being shown. You can propose it again later.
connections_done_outside: Connection added. It is shown on your page as unverified.
connections_failed: That did not work. Please try again.
connections_error_exists: This connection already exists or is waiting for an answer.
connections_error_cooldown: This connection was declined recently. Try again in a few weeks.
connections_error_limit: You have reached today's limit of proposals. Try again tomorrow.
connections_error_target_unavailable: That listing is not available for connections.
connections_field_outside: The partner is not listed here
connections_search_placeholder: Type at least 2 letters of the name
connections_evidence_hint_outside: Required. A page that shows this connection, such as a project page or a news article.
connections_evidence_hint: Optional. A page that shows this connection.
connections_err_url: Enter a web address that starts with http or https.
connections_err_end_year: The end year cannot be before the start year.
connections_role_member_of_outgoing: My listing is a member of the partner
connections_role_member_of_incoming: The partner is a member of my listing
connections_graph_label: Diagram of this listing and its connections. The list below has the same information.
connections_unverified_hint: This listing added these without confirmation from the partner.
connections_export_links_intro: Downloads every confirmed connection between published listings as a CSV file, including links to unverified outside partners (marked in the unverified column).
connections_export_failed: The export failed. Please try again.
